verdict.rationale: Paxos lets you create deposit addresses via its own API (docs-50 describes creating one in Sandbox) and generate fiat deposit instructions (docs-40). It also onboards person and institution identities, and its payments product mentions reconciliation. However, the evidence never states that addresses or deposit instructions are issued per customer or identity so incoming funds are attributed automatically. Missing for 10: explicit per-customer or per-identity deposit addresses or virtual accounts, documentation tying incoming deposits to a named customer for automatic reconciliation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
